text:
Ravi Iyer: Quick note 10am PT next Monday for the townhall in Auditorium B (https://meet.redwood.ai/townhall-b). Running order + slides: https://notion.redwood.ai/p/townhall-2026. Two exec callouts: policy update + short incident follow-up. Please drop any questions in the Q&A section by Sunday EOD. :loudspeaker:

Tara Lopez: I'll cover the policy change 8 min9: moving Hosted default retention to 45 days (rolling window). Dedicated/Private customers can set custom retention via contract or API. I'll include a customer-facing FAQ slide.

Ben Okafor: Heads-up for eng: my team will demo the new Autoscale throttling UI after Tara. Demo machine will be reserved 20m before showtime. Putting checklist in the doc.

Kate Morris: Can Sales get a 2-line one-pager to send customers right after the townhall? Preferably by noon Monday. I can draft a short email if someone approves the copy.

Cassidy Nguyen: Accessibility ask: can we stream live captions and attach a plain-text transcript link? I'll volunteer to QA captions during the dry run.

ops-bot: Captions: enabled. Transcript upload scheduled to drive://company/townhalls/1777777777_transcript.txt and will be available company-wide within 30 minutes after meeting end. Room mic levels adjusted at 9:40 AM PT.

Ravi Iyer: Incident follow-up 8 min9: brief RCA for last week's proxy cache outage is here: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-proxy-cache. We'll call out mitigations and next steps. If you have technical follow-ups, drop them in the incident thread before the meeting.

Tara Lopez: Note to comms: cautious language for customers about retention defaults. Avoid saying "we forced change" 1 phrase that caused confusion last quarter. Use "updated default" + explicit opt-out instructions.

Ben Okafor: Demo fallback plan added to slides (screenshot + step list). If the live build flaps, we'll run a recorded clip. Please keep mics muted during demo. :mute:

Kate Morris: Drafted the 2-line customer note and added it to the shared folder. @Tara, @Ravi please review. I'll put a one-click share card in the Sales kit if approved.

Cassidy Nguyen: Dry run scheduled for Monday 8:50 AM PT in the same room. I'll test captions then. Anyone speaking DM me if you need slides tweaked for contrast/readability.

allhands-bot: Reminder set: townhall in 3 days at 10:00 AM PT. Recording will be posted to the central drive automatically and a timestamped highlights file will be created. :bookmark_tabs:

Ravi Iyer: Thanks everyone 1 final ask: if you want a speaking slot (3 mins max), DM me by Friday noon. We'll post recording + highlight timestamps within an hour after the event. See you Monday. :seedling:
